#!/bin/bash -l
echo "start f1 ros nodes... " >> /tmp/f1.log
# 启动所有相机和机械臂节点
# ===== 关键：加载完整用户环境 =====
source /home/user/.bashrc
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.sh

# ===== 加载各个工作空间的环境 =====
source /home/user/workspace/f1/install/setup.sh
source /home/user/workspace/camera/OrbbecSDK_ROS2/install/setup.sh
source /home/user/workspace/camera/ros2_ws/install/setup.sh
#source /home/user/workspace/agv/install/setup.sh

# ===== 设置 ROS2 相关环境变量 =====
# export RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp

# 获取脚本所在目录
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# 日志目录
LOG_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs2"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

echo "启动机械臂运动学节点..."
ros2 launch motor_ctl kinematics.launch.xml> "$LOG_DIR/kine_arm.log" 2>&1 &

echo "启动机械臂电机节点..."
ros2 launch motor_ctl motor_ctl.launch.xml > "$LOG_DIR/motor_ctl.log" 2>&1 &

sleep 2



echo "启动头部奥比相机..."
ros2 launch orbbec_camera head_gemini330.launch.py > "$LOG_DIR/head_camera.log" 2>&1 &

sleep 2

echo "启动右手腕相机..."
ros2 launch realsense2_camera rs_launch_right_wrist_d405.py > "$LOG_DIR/right_wrist.log" 2>&1 &

sleep 2

echo "启动左手腕相机..."
ros2 launch realsense2_camera rs_launch_left_wrist_d405.py > "$LOG_DIR/left_wrist.log" 2>&1 &

sleep 2

echo "启动升降控制节点..."
# ==================== Conda 环境激活 ====================
CONDA_BASE="/home/user/miniconda3"
source "${CONDA_BASE}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
echo "Conda 环境 ${ENV_NAME} 已成功激活"
conda deactivate
/home/user/workspace/EC_Line_Control/start_waist_updown_ros2.sh

sleep 2
echo "启动一键复位节点..."
/home/user/workspace/whole_body_ctl/start_whole_body_ctl.sh

sleep 2
echo "启动手柄控制节点..."
/home/user/workspace/whole_body_ctl/gamepad_get_send/start_gamepad_ctl.sh

echo "所有节点已启动！"
echo "f1 ros nodes started... " >> /tmp/f1.log

files./home/user/lxl/start_all_pico1.sh:
#!/bin/bash

echo "=== 开始启动三个程序 (nohup 后台模式) ==="

# ==================== ROS2 环境激活 ====================
#
# 必须先 source ROS2，再 source 自定义消息，最后激活 conda
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
source ~/workspace/f1/install/setup.bash

# ==================== Conda 环境激活 ====================
CONDA_BASE="/home/user/miniconda3"
ENV_NAME="pico4ultra_py312"
source "${CONDA_BASE}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
conda activate ${ENV_NAME} || {
    echo "❌ Conda 环境激活失败！"
    exit 1
}

echo "✅ Conda 环境 ${ENV_NAME} 已成功激活"

sleep 1

# ==================== 第一个程序 (加密版) ====================
echo "1. 启动 all_remote_lxl.py [加密版] ..."
cd /home/user/lxl/remote_sth/dist
nohup python all_remote_lxl.py > ../remote.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2

# ==================== 第二个程序 (加密版) ====================
echo "2. 启动 teleop_lxl.py [加密版] ..."
cd /home/user/lxl/XRoboToolkit-Teleop-Sample-Python/dist

# 确保入口文件同级目录有 pyarmor_runtime（首次运行时复制，后续跳过）
if [ ! -d "scripts/simulation/pyarmor_runtime_000000" ]; then
    cp -r pyarmor_runtime_000000 scripts/simulation/
fi

# 设置 .so 库路径（SDK 动态库）
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/user/lxl/XRoboToolkit-Teleop-Sample-Python/dependencies/XRoboToolkit-PC-Service-Pybind/lib/aarch64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
# 设置 PYTHONPATH 让加密版能找到 dist/ 根目录的包（xrobotoolkit_teleop 等）
export PYTHONPATH=/home/user/lxl/XRoboToolkit-Teleop-Sample-Python/dist:$PYTHONPATH

nohup python scripts/simulation/teleop_lxl.py > ../teleop.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2

# ==================== 第三个程序 (原生二进制) ====================
echo "3. 启动 Roboticsservice (runService.sh) ..."
cd /opt/apps/roboticsservice
nohup ./runService.sh > roboticsservice.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3

echo ""
echo "✅ 三个程序已在后台启动！"
echo ""

# ---------- 启动成功检测 ----------
echo "当前进程检测结果（判断是否启动成功）："
ps aux | grep -E 'all_remote_lxl|teleop_lxl|runService|RoboticsServiceProcess' | grep -v grep

echo ""
echo "日志查看命令："
echo "   tail -f ~/lxl/remote_sth/remote.log"
echo "   tail -f ~/lxl/XRoboToolkit-Teleop-Sample-Python/teleop.log"
echo "   tail -f /opt/apps/roboticsservice/roboticsservice.log"

echo ""
echo "如果需要停止程序，请运行：./stop_all_pico.sh"
